mapper.select: WITH l AS ( SELECT d.district_key, d.municipality_code, coalesce(d.name_en, x.name_en) AS name, x.name_ar, (s.in_scope IS DISTINCT FROM false) AS in_scope, s.score_existing, s.score_current, s.score_target, s.parks, s.park_area_ha, s.park_gap_ha, s.is_sample, s.source_as_of, s.capex_aed, s.opex_aed, s.capex_tier_target_aed, s.tier, s.tier_rule, s.tier_triggers, s.liv_district_id, s.calc_version_id, round(ST_X(theme.inner_point(d.geom))::numeric, 6) AS cx, round(ST_Y(theme.inner_point(d.geom))::numeric, 6) AS cy FROM stat.stat_district_liveability s JOIN stat.dim_district x ON x.code = s.district_code JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.municipality_code = upper(x.municipality) AND d.district_id = x.makani_district_id ), r AS ( SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN in_scope THEN rank() OVER (PARTITION BY in_scope ORDER BY score_current DESC) END AS rk, CASE WHEN in_scope THEN rank() OVER (PARTITION BY in_scope, municipality_code ORDER BY score_current DESC) END AS muni_rk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_scope) OVER () AS scope_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_scope) OVER (PARTITION BY municipality_code) AS muni_scope_n FROM l ) SELECT district_key AS "key", name AS "name", name_ar AS "nameAr", municipality_code AS "municipalityCode", in_scope AS "inScope", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_existing END AS "existing", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_current END AS "pipeline", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_target END AS "target", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN round(score_target - score_current, 2) END AS "gap", rk AS "rank", scope_n AS "rankOf", muni_rk AS "muniRank", muni_scope_n AS "muniRankOf", parks AS "parks", park_area_ha AS "parkAreaHa", park_gap_ha AS "parkGapHa", is_sample AS "sample", coalesce(capex_tier_target_aed, capex_aed) AS "capexAed", CASE WHEN capex_tier_target_aed IS NOT NULL THEN 'tier_target' WHEN capex_aed IS NOT NULL THEN 'total' END AS "capexBasis", capex_aed AS "capexTotalAed", opex_aed AS "opexAed", capex_tier_target_aed AS "capexTierTargetAed", tier AS "tier", tier_rule AS "tierRule", tier_triggers AS "tierTriggers", liv_district_id AS "livDistrictId", calc_version_id AS "calcVersionId", cx AS "cx", cy AS "cy", to_char(source_as_of, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "asOf" FROM r WHERE true AND municipality_code = #{municipality} AND district_key = #{district} ORDER BY in_scope DESC, score_current DESC NULLS LAST, name

SELECT g.rk AS "rank", g.facility AS "facility", g.category AS "category", g.score_existing AS "existing", g.score_pipeline AS "pipeline", g.score_ap50 AS "ap50", g.target_pct AS "target", g.gap AS "gap" FROM stat.stat_district_liv_facility_gap g JOIN stat.dim_district x ON x.code = g.district_code JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.municipality_code = upper(x.municipality) AND d.district_id = x.makani_district_id WHERE d.district_key = #{district} ORDER BY g.rk LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.rk AS "rank", n.item AS "item", n.pct AS "pct", n.votes AS "votes", n.respondents AS "respondents" FROM stat.stat_district_liv_need n JOIN stat.dim_district x ON x.code = n.district_code JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.municipality_code = upper(x.municipality) AND d.district_id = x.makani_district_id WHERE d.district_key = #{district} ORDER BY n.rk

WITH c AS ( SELECT n.facility_type, sum(n.n) AS n FROM stat.stat_district_liv_facility_count n JOIN stat.dim_district x ON x.code = n.district_code JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.municipality_code = upper(x.municipality) AND d.district_id = x.makani_district_id WHERE true AND d.municipality_code = #{municipality} AND d.district_key = #{district} GROUP BY n.facility_type ) SELECT t.category AS "category", t.category_label AS "categoryLabel", t.facility_type AS "type", t.type_label AS "label", coalesce(c.n, 0)::int AS "n" FROM stat.stat_liv_facility_type t LEFT JOIN c ON c.facility_type = t.facility_type ORDER BY t.category, coalesce(c.n, 0) DESC, t.type_label
